description: Dynamic loss at 100 ms RTT (specs.md 17.3, 19 row E8): loss rising mid-transfer, loss falling mid-transfer, and an irregular schedule crossing the dead band repeatedly. The adaptive system is the one under test, so the hybrid runs alone here; its fixed comparators at the same loss levels are E1-E6. Step times are chosen against the measured length of a 1 MiB transfer on this bed (16 s clean, 68-137 s at 20% loss), so every step is reached before the transfer ends.

conditions.name: loss_rise
conditions.description: Clean, then 10% loss from 8 s: the transfer starts in GBN (config.DEFAULT_MODE) and has to detect the change and enter SR.

conditions.name: loss_fall
conditions.description: 10% loss, then clean from 20 s: the return to GBN, which no static condition exercises at all. The hysteresis count of 3 needs roughly 110 segments of post-change traffic to confirm, so the clean phase is left long enough to contain that (calibration.md 5).

conditions.name: loss_change
conditions.description: An irregular schedule crossing the crossover four times: 2% -> 12% -> 1% -> 15% -> 2%. This is the condition that separates an adaptive controller from a twitchy one, since a schedule that changes once cannot (calibration.md 3).
